name: Buy Astra Pain Syrup 100ml
description:
Buy Astra Pain Syrup

Buy Astra Pain Syrup 100ml is a pain-relief syrup that contains codeine, an opioid medicine used for the short-term treatment of pain and, in some formulations, cough symptoms.

Common Uses | Astra Syrup for sale

Temporary relief of mild to moderate pain.

Relief of certain cough symptoms, depending on the formulation

Management of discomfort associated with cold and flu symptoms in some cases
